summary: Hong Kong-based King Resources Global, Inc. (OTC: KRFG) reported that its wholly owned subsidiary Heavenly Grace entered three separate purchase agreements dated November 3-5, 2026 with Herbertini Limited, Silver Bloom Properties Limited, and Grand View Assets Limited to acquire 7, 13, and 9 collectible items, respectively. Total consideration is $4,418,165, $9,062,214, and $8,781,280, aggregating roughly $22.26 million, payable entirely in KRFG common stock priced at $0.236 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timetable disclosed. Watch dilution, share issuance volume, and related-party or valuation concerns around collectibles-for-stock deals.
